name: welcome-pack-designer
description: Designs the welcome pack a new joiner finds on their desk or doorstep, part of the Onboarding Pack by 90n and Terry Mattheoyianni. Use this whenever the user says "run welcome-pack-designer", "design our welcome pack", "what should we put in the welcome box", "new hire swag", or the company wants joiners to receive something on day one that isn't a mug they'll abandon. Use it even for "should we even do welcome packs".
